channel.title: Best Little Sites - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: ALIEN: EARTH Star Sydney Chandler Reveals Exciting Season 2 Production Update
item.description: Alien: Earth premiered on FX last year, and lead star Sydney Chandler has now revealed when Season 2 begins shooting in London's Pinewood Studios after moving out of Thailand.

item.title: WAR MACHINE Rotten Tomatoes Score Revealed As Alan Ritchson's New Sci-Fi Thriller Hits Netflix
item.description: Reacher star Alan Ritchson's new sci-fi action thriller, War Machine, is now on Netflix, and the first reviews have landed along with an early Rotten Tomatoes score...

item.title: THE ORVILLE Season 4 Is Already Written, Reveals Creator Seth MacFarlane
item.description: The Orville Season 4 is already written, but fans of the sci-fi series will have to continue to wait as Seth MacFarlane's busy schedule remains the series' biggest hurdle.

item.title: IRON MAN Star Terrence Howard Has A Wild New Theory About Why Marvel Fired Him
item.description: Terrence Howard was fired from Iron Man 2 due to a widely reported pay dispute, but in a new interview, the Empire star shares a new theory as to why Marvel dropped his version of Rhodey.

item.title: DEADPOOL Star T.J. Miller Teases Ryan Reynolds' DEADPOOL 4 Plans And Possible MCU Debut As Weasel
item.description: Deadpool star T.J. Miller has revealed that he's spoken with Ryan Reynolds about the Merc with the Mouth's MCU future and strongly hints that the door may be open to more Weasel.

item.title: STREET FIGHTER International Teasers Feature New Footage; Reboot Sets Japan Release Date
item.description: Though it's not much, we finally have a look at some new footage from the upcoming Street Fighter reboot via an international teaser and behind-the-scenes featurette...

item.title: As WOLVERINE Movie Rumors Resurface, Fans Ask: "Should Hugh Jackman Return as Logan?"
item.description: Rumours about Marvel Studios' plans for a Wolverine movie are once again doing the rounds, leading to renewed speculation about Hugh Jackman donning Logan's claws...until he's 90.

item.title: HARRY POTTER Set Photos Reveal Massive Diagon Alley Set And A First Look At Gringotts Wizarding Bank
item.description: New Harry Potter set photos reveal our first look at Diagon Alley, Gringotts Wizarding Bank, Hagrid's hut, and the full version of Privet Drive, explaining the show's supposed huge budget.

item.title: STAR WARS: James Mangold's DAWN OF THE JEDI Reportedly DEAD Under New Lucasfilm Leadership
item.description: It seems Logan director James Mangold won't be heading into a Galaxy Far, Far Away after all, as a new rumour claims that his Dawn of the Jedi movie is now "dead" at Lucasfilm.
